about.heading: A small Toronto studio with a film-set imagination.
about.text: ZhioStudio is a Toronto-based creative studio by NexAIS. We make cinematic advertising, premium visual content and websites for local businesses — cafés, restaurants, florists, dessert shops and the neighbourhood brands people love. Every film in the showroom above is a concept piece we produced to show what is possible for a business like yours; when you work with us, your products, your prices and your brand are the stars.

terms: All prices in CAD, plus applicable taxes. Films and websites delivered in 3–5 business days with 2 revisions included. Monthly plans are billed monthly. Pay securely online via Stripe using the Buy buttons on each package, or send an order request by email — questions anytime at zhiostutio@gmail.com, we reply within one business day.
